questions.leftContentHTML:
Don,
The car wouldn’t start this morning so I got a taxi to work. The second time this week! Can you tell your dad to phone the garage for me and get someone to come to see it again?
Tell him the brakes may need fixing, too.
Mum

options.text: Don's mum wants Don to contact his father and let him know about her car trouble.
Don is expected to call the garage in order to arrange an appointment.
Don's mum is checking whether Don has remembered to contact the garage.

questions.hint: Notice that Mum asks Don to tell Dad to telephone the garage, not to call it himself.

questions.leftContentHTML:
ATTENTION
All student accommodation must be paid by the last day of the month.

If paid by the 25th of each month, students get a discount of 5%.

Office hours: 9-5 Monday to Friday.

options.text: Students should pay for their accommodation by the 25th.
Students have the chance to get 5% off their accommodation if they pay for the year.
It is necessary to make all accommodation payments by the end of the month.

questions.hint: Distinguish the deadline (last day of the month) from the earlier date for the 5% discount.

questions.leftContentHTML:
COFFEE SHOP OPENING HOURS
Monday to Friday 9.30-6.00pm.
Wednesday half day until 1.00pm.
Weekends open until 5.00pm
(every third Saturday until 10.00pm).

options.text: You can buy coffee until 10pm most Saturdays.
On Wednesdays coffee is not served late in the afternoon.
Coffee is not served after 5pm on any weekends.

questions.hint: On Wednesdays the shop closes at 1.00pm, earlier than on other weekdays.

questions.leftContentHTML:
To: Hazel
From: Tim
Re: Dinner

Hi Hazel!
I can’t make it for dinner on Friday, so can we arrange Saturday? If you are free, call me, or we can go next weekend.
Love
Tim

options.text: to let her know there's been a change of plan
to suggest another activity rather than going out to eat
to remind her she should call him on Friday

questions.hint: Tim cannot make Friday dinner, but proposes Saturday or next weekend.

questions.leftContentHTML:
JOIN US AT THE GYM
• Great discounts on membership this week
• Open 24 hours
• Classes from 8am to 8pm
(Saturday morning: only for kids)

options.text: It is cheaper to join the gym if you do so this week.
Weekend classes at the gym are offered for everyone.

questions.hint: The gym is open 24 hours, but classes run only 8am–8pm; the membership discount lasts this week.

explanation.key: A đúng: Mum asks Don to tell his dad to phone the garage. B sai vì Don không được yêu cầu tự gọi garage. C sai vì Mum chưa nhờ Don liên lạc trực tiếp với garage trước đó.

C đúng vì thông báo nói all student accommodation must be paid by the last day of the month. A nhầm hạn nhận giảm giá 25th với hạn thanh toán cuối tháng. B sai vì giảm 5% nếu trả sớm mỗi tháng, không phải trả cho cả năm.
B đúng vì vào Wednesday coffee shop đóng lúc 1pm, nên không bán cà phê vào cuối buổi chiều. A sai vì 10pm chỉ áp dụng every third Saturday. C sai vì thứ Bảy thứ ba hằng kỳ có thể mở đến 10pm.
A đúng: Tim không thể đi ăn tối thứ Sáu như kế hoạch và muốn đổi sang thứ Bảy hoặc cuối tuần sau. B sai vì vẫn là dinner, không phải hoạt động khác. C sai vì anh không yêu cầu Hazel gọi vào thứ Sáu.
B đúng vì gym quảng cáo 'Great discounts on membership this week'. A sai vì cơ sở mở 24 giờ nhưng classes chỉ từ 8am đến 8pm. C sai vì Saturday morning chỉ dành cho kids.
